description: Nigeria Human Capital Development Program Phase II — $1.5B IDA credit supporting education, health, and social protection systems strengthening for 210M+ population
Ethiopia Productive Safety Net Program Phase 5 (PSNP5) — $800M IDA credit for food security, climate resilience, and social safety net for 8M+ chronically food-insecure beneficiaries
Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration Project — $600M IDA/IBRD blend promoting digital infrastructure, e-government, and digital financial services
Tanzania Transport & Logistics Modernisation Project — $850M IDA credit rehabilitating 2,400km of roads and upgrading Dar es Salaam port logistics corridors
DRC Eastern Congo Stabilisation & Recovery Programme — $900M IDA credit addressing conflict-affected communities with infrastructure, livelihoods, and state institution rebuilding
Ghana Private Sector Competitiveness & Innovation Programme — $400M IBRD loan supporting export diversification, SME financing, and investment climate reforms

Zambia AgriConnect Digital Agriculture Platform — $450M IDA flagship initiative connecting 2M+ smallholder farmers to markets, credit, and inputs via mobile and satellite technology. Part of the $2.5B Digital Development Partnership (2023)
Zambia Education for Employment & Skills Development Project — $180M IDA credit improving TVET quality, graduate employability, and digital skills for Zambian youth
Bangladesh Climate-Resilient Coastal Infrastructure Project — $800M IDA credit strengthening coastal embankments, cyclone shelters, and climate-adaptive infrastructure for 40M coastal residents
Indonesia Green Cities & Sustainable Infrastructure Programme — $1.2B IBRD loan financing low-carbon urban transport, waste management, and green building standards across 10 major cities

Brazil Amazon Sustainable Land Management Programme — $500M IBRD loan supporting deforestation reduction, sustainable agriculture intensification, and indigenous territory protection in the Amazon biome
India National Water Security Mission — $2.5B IBRD loan improving water storage, irrigation efficiency, and urban water supply for 50M+ beneficiaries across 12 water-stressed states

Pakistan Energy Sector Transformation Programme — $1.0B IDA credit supporting power sector reforms, renewable energy transition, and circular debt reduction in Pakistan's crisis-affected energy sector

Multi-country AgriConnect Africa Regional Programme — $2.0B IDA regional programme operating in Zambia (lead), Kenya, Ethiopia, Tanzania, and Nigeria, scaling digital agriculture services to 10M+ smallholder farmers across Sub-Saharan Africa
